name: Tobias
background: A wealthy linen merchant who operates a shop near the Temple Mount. He provides ceremonial items for Passover preparations.

dialogue.neutral: Business is brisk this week. Everyone needs something for the Passover.
dialogue.cautious: I keep to myself mostly. These are dangerous times.
dialogue.pressured: I heard things in the marketplace. Men making plans in hushed tones.
dialogue.exposed: Enough! I saw the transaction happen. Thirty silver pieces changed hands for a kiss.
